name: Looq: Preview Files for Mac
soft_passes: #1 respects the squircle but delivered pre-masked (transparent corners baked into a 256px web render), not a full-bleed 1024 square
#2 horizontally centred but arc mass sits in the upper two-thirds; optically top-weighted, lower third empty
#8 bands internally coherent but glyph floats with no grounding shadow — reads as a printed plate
#9 modern squircle container wrapped around baked skeuomorphic chrome-gloss lighting; a deliberate era mix (quotation)
failures: #4 16px squint: 5 nested arcs (~10px band+gap at 256px) go sub-pixel at 16px and merge into a grey dome — the layered-rainbow detail smears
#10 variant robustness: baked black-background-dependent art + baked chrome specular; not Icon Composer layers, would not survive tinted/clear/dark-adaptive renders
light_model: Top-down; each of the 5 arc bands carries a baked white specular crest along its top edge fading to grey below (cylindrical/tubular chrome shading); background also lighter at top. No cast/drop shadow. Specular is baked into the art, not system-applied.
layer_stack: nested chrome arc bands with baked per-band highlights
devices: monochrome chrome rainbow (spectrum motif stripped of colour, cast in polished metal)
per-band tubular specular (white crest -> grey belly per arc)
rhymes_hint: dark-chrome skeuomorphic utility marks — polished-metal-on-black in the pro-audio / Quicksilver / spectrum-analyser lineage; monochrome chrome glyph + tenebrous ramp + baked top specular
notes: Source is a 256x256 downsized web render (not a 1024 master); corners arrive pre-masked (alpha=0), so true mask-edge behaviour and fine detail are unverifiable and slightly softened. Brightest glyph pixel hits pure #FFFFFF specular; darkest bg is true #000000. Achromatic palette is a whole-brand choice, not an icon quirk: the cover ('Built to render the rest of your files.') is strictly black/white/silver, so the colourless rainbow coheres deliberately. App is a Quick Look renderer/previewer (Markdown, code, SQLite, archives) — the rainbow/spectrum reads as 'previews everything'. Container is a Big-Sur-shape squircle but the material treatment (baked chrome gloss + black gradient) quotes classic skeuomorphic metal; not a Liquid Glass icon.
